info.title: PodNest API
info.description:
REST API for the PodNest admin panel. Every endpoint requires an authenticated session (cookie) with appropriate role. Path parameter `{id}` is the site ID except under the Users tag, where it is the user ID.

**Note:** request/response schemas are being documented incrementally; endpoints not yet enriched show a generic body.

tags.name: Sites
tags.description: Site CRUD, lifecycle (start/stop/restart/recreate), clone, and image pruning.

tags.name: Backups
tags.description: Per-site backup create/list/restore/download and import (SFTP/upload).

tags.name: Basic Auth
tags.description: Per-site HTTP basic-auth realm and user management.

tags.name: Cron
tags.description: Per-site cron job CRUD, toggle, and run-now.

tags.name: Database
tags.description: Per-site database dump, import, search-replace, and optimize/repair.

tags.name: Domains
tags.description: Per-site domain attach/detach and listing.

tags.name: File Manager
tags.description: Per-site file manager: list, read, write, upload, download, copy, move, chmod, mkdir, delete.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User CRUD and per-user TOTP enrollment.

tags.name: Audit Log
tags.description: Admin-only audit log read endpoint.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description: Global and per-site proxy/WAF/container log streaming.

tags.name: Security
tags.description: Global IP/UA rules, security bypass list, and import/export.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Global settings: resources, backup, notifications, trusted proxies, WAF, import/export.

tags.name: WAF
tags.description: Per-site WAF toggles, exclusions, CRS plugins, and import/export; global and per-site auto-ban settings and ban lists.

tags.name: Configs

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Container health streaming and per-container restart.

tags.name: Redirects

tags.name: SFTP

get.description: Returns malware_retain_days, malware_memory_mb, and malware_cpus. Empty values mean the defaults (30 days, 2048 MB, 1 CPU) apply. Admin only.

put.description: Validates every value before saving any. Bounds: malware_retain_days 1-3650, malware_memory_mb 512-65536 (whole numbers), malware_cpus 0.1-64. Admin only.

get.description: Returns the site's scan history newest first, each scan with its findings, plus whether the site has an html directory to scan and the retention window in days. Status: 1 running, 2 clean, 3 infected, 4 error.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

post.summary: Scan a site for malware now
post.description: Queues an immediate scan and returns its ID without waiting. Scans run one at a time host-wide.

409.description: A scan is already queued or running for this site

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

post.description: Moves the finding's file out of the site's html directory into the panel-only quarantine store and marks every finding for that path as quarantined.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

parameters.name: findingID
parameters.description: Malware finding ID.

get.description: Returns the site's cached update status from the last nightly (11 PM) or manual check: core_version, core_update (empty when current), plugins and themes with updates available (name, title, version, update_version), error, and checked. status is null until the first check. WordPress sites only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

post.description: Runs a WP-CLI update check against the site, caches the result, and returns the fresh status. A failed check is cached with its error. The site must be running.

400.description: Not a WordPress site, or site not running

409.description: An update check or update is already running for this site

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket and streams a WP-CLI update run. core runs core update then core update-db; plugins runs plugin update --all; themes runs theme update --all; all runs every step in that order. The run stops at the first failing command, then rechecks and caches the site's status. The final frame is [done] or an [error] line. Same-origin only; the site must be running.

400.description: Not a WordPress site, invalid scope, or site not running

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: What to update.

get.description: Returns selected (the WordPress user ID used for wp-admin SSO, 0 = the site's first administrator) and, when the site is running, admins (id, login, display_name). If the administrators cannot be listed, error carries the reason and admins is empty.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

put.description: Stores the WordPress user every panel user signs in as. 0 clears the selection so the site's first administrator is used. If the stored user is no longer an administrator when a link is used, the site falls back to its first administrator.

400.description: Not a WordPress site, or invalid wp_user_id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

post.description: Returns url, a single-use wp-login.php link valid for 60 seconds that signs in as the selected administrator. The token is an HMAC keyed off the site's AUTH_KEY and AUTH_SALT and is verified by the managed, read-only podnest-sso mu-plugin. The site must be running and define both salts as plain string literals in wp-config.php.

400.description: Not a WordPress site, or site not running

422.description: AUTH_KEY or AUTH_SALT cannot be read from wp-config.php

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Site ID.

put.summary: Block or unblock a synced user
put.description: Admin only. Sets the blocked flag on a user synced from this node's parent. A blocked user's sessions end immediately and their SSO hops from the parent are refused; the flag survives every sync. Local users cannot be blocked, and an admin cannot block themselves.

400.description: Not a synced user, or own account

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID.

post.description: Admin only. Issues a single-use pairing code that expires after 5 minutes and is bound to the URL the request was made on. Issuing a new code replaces any outstanding one. Refused once this node has a parent.

409.description: This node already has a parent, or has children

post.description: Admin only. Records a pending child with a fresh link keypair and returns a link that carries the signed pairing assertion to the child. Open it in the browser; the child redirects back to /node/ack, which marks the node as paired.

url.description: The child's URL, exactly as shown with its pairing code.

post.description: Admin only. Commits the pending pair, update, or unpair operation that matches the acknowledgement secret the child returned. Each secret can be used once and expires after 5 minutes. Op 1 = pair, 2 = update, 3 = unpair.

put.description: Admin only. A rename applies immediately. A URL change or re-key (paired nodes only) returns a link carrying a signed update to the child; the new URL and key take effect only once the child acknowledges it.

200.description: Success — link is present when the change has to be applied on the child

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Node ID.

delete.description: Admin only. A pending node is removed immediately. A paired node returns a link carrying a signed unpair; the child drops this parent and its synced users, and the node is removed once that is acknowledged. With force=1 the node is removed here without contacting the child.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Node ID.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: 1 removes the node here without contacting the child.

post.description: Admin only, paired nodes only. Returns a link carrying a signed, single-use SSO assertion (valid for 60 seconds) for the calling admin, together with this node's current admin list. The child syncs its users against that list and starts a session.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Node ID.
